tool_schemas.name: tavily-search
tool_schemas.description: Runs a web search for the provided query and returns up to max_results ranked results, optionally including a synthesized answer, raw extracted page content, and image metadata; results are returned as a single page (no pagination token) limited by max_results. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing, max_results < 1, enums are invalid, URLs/domains are malformed, or start_date is after end_date; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the API client is missing or not permitted to use search; raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the client has no remaining search quota. Raises CONFLICT when the same idempotency_key is reused with different parameters, otherwise the original response is returned for safe retries.

query.description: Search query text to run against the web index.

search_depth.description: Controls how thorough the search is (speed vs recall).

max_results.description: Maximum number of search results to return.

include_answer.description: Whether to include a synthesized answer generated from top results.

include_raw_content.description: Whether to include extracted raw page content for each result when available.

include_images.description: Whether to include image results/metadata when available.

time_range.description: Limit results to the given recency window.

start_date.description: Only include documents published/fetched on or after this timestamp (ISO 8601).

end_date.description: Only include documents published/fetched on or before this timestamp (ISO 8601).

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key for safely retrying the same search without duplication.

tool_schemas.name: tavily-extract
tool_schemas.description: Fetches and extracts content for one or more URLs and returns an extraction result per URL, optionally including raw page content and discovered image metadata; the response is not paginated and is limited to the submitted url list. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when urls is empty, any url is not a valid URI, or extract_depth is not one of the allowed values; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the API client is missing or not permitted to use extraction; raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the client has no remaining extract quota. Raises CONFLICT when the same idempotency_key is reused with different parameters, otherwise returns the previously created extraction results for that key.

urls.description: One or more URLs to fetch and extract content from.

include_images.description: Whether to include image URLs/metadata discovered on the page.

include_raw_content.description: Whether to include raw extracted page content in the response.

extract_depth.description: Controls how thoroughly the extractor processes the page (speed vs completeness).

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key for safely retrying the same extraction without duplication.

tool_schemas.name: tavily-crawl
tool_schemas.description: Creates a long-running crawl job starting from the base url, following links up to max_depth and stopping at max_pages, applying host/path constraints and optionally fetching/storing page content; returns the created job and its initial status (results are produced asynchronously by the job). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when url is not a valid URI, max_depth < 0, max_pages < 1, or path prefix filters are invalid; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the API client is missing or not permitted to run crawls; raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the client has no remaining crawl quota. Raises CONFLICT when the same idempotency_key is reused with different parameters, otherwise returns the existing crawl job for that key and does not create a duplicate job.

url.description: Base URL to start crawling from.

max_depth.description: Maximum link depth to crawl from the base page.

max_pages.description: Maximum number of pages to fetch during the crawl.

allowed_path_prefixes.description: Only crawl URLs whose path begins with one of these prefixes.

blocked_path_prefixes.description: Do not crawl URLs whose path begins with one of these prefixes.

same_host_only.description: If true, restrict crawling to the base URL host only.

fetch_content.description: If true, fetch and store page content for crawled pages; otherwise only discover URLs.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key for safely retrying the same crawl without creating a duplicate job.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def tavily_crawl(url, max_depth=None, max_pages=None, allowed_path_prefixes=None, blocked_path_prefixes=None, same_host_only=None, fetch_content=None, idempotency_key=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, hashlib, secrets
    from urllib.parse import urlsplit, urlunsplit

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0424000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0424000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now_dt = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0)
    now_iso = now_dt.isoformat() + "Z"
    tool = "tavily-crawl"

    def _month_key(dt):
        return f"{dt.year:04d}-{dt.month:02d}"

    def _parse_iso(s):
        if not s or not isinstance(s, str):
            return None
        try:
            if s.endswith("Z"):
                s = s[:-1] + "+00:00"
            return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(s)
        except Exception:
            return None

    def _new_id(prefix):
        return f"{prefix}_{secrets.token_hex(12)}"

    def _normalize_url(u):
        if not isinstance(u, str) or not u.strip():
            return None
        u = u.strip()
        try:
            parts = urlsplit(u)
        except Exception:
            return None
        scheme = (parts.scheme or "").lower()
        if scheme not in ("http", "https"):
            return None
        if not parts.netloc:
            return None
        host = (parts.hostname or "").lower()
        if not host:
            return None
        port = parts.port
        netloc = host
        if port and not ((scheme == "http" and port == 80) or (scheme == "https" and port == 443)):
            netloc = f"{host}:{port}"
        path = parts.path or "/"
        if not path.startswith("/"):
            path = "/" + path
        while "//" in path:
            path = path.replace("//", "/")
        query = parts.query or ""
        canonical = urlunsplit((scheme, netloc, path, query, ""))  # strip fragment
        return canonical, host

    def _url_hash(canonical):
        return hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

    def _log_request(requests_rows, api_key_id, status, input_obj, response_obj, http_status, error_code=None, error_message=None, tokens_used=0, result_count=None, idem=None, normalized_target=None, started_at=None, finished_at=None):
        rid = _new_id("tav_req")
        row = {
            "id": rid,
            "api_key_id": api_key_id,
            "tool": tool,
            "status": status,
            "idempotency_key": idem,
            "input": input_obj if isinstance(input_obj, dict) else {},
            "normalized_target": normalized_target,
            "response": response_obj,
            "error_code": error_code,
            "error_message": error_message,
            "http_status": http_status,
            "tokens_used": int(tokens_used) if isinstance(tokens_used, int) and tokens_used >= 0 else 0,
            "result_count": result_count,
            "started_at": started_at,
            "finished_at": finished_at,
            "created_at": now_iso,
            "updated_at": now_iso,
        }
        requests_rows.append(row)
        return row

    # ---- validation
    norm = _normalize_url(url)
    if norm is None:
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "url must be a valid http/https URI")
    canonical_url, host = norm

    if max_depth is not None and (not isinstance(max_depth, int) or max_depth < 0):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "max_depth must be an integer >= 0")
    if max_pages is not None and (not isinstance(max_pages, int) or max_pages < 1):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "max_pages must be an integer >= 1")
    if allowed_path_prefixes is not None and (not isinstance(allowed_path_prefixes, list) or any(not isinstance(x, str) for x in allowed_path_prefixes)):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "allowed_path_prefixes must be an array of strings")
    if blocked_path_prefixes is not None and (not isinstance(blocked_path_prefixes, list) or any(not isinstance(x, str) for x in blocked_path_prefixes)):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "blocked_path_prefixes must be an array of strings")
    if same_host_only is not None and not isinstance(same_host_only, bool):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "same_host_only must be a boolean")
    if fetch_content is not None and not isinstance(fetch_content, bool):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "fetch_content must be a boolean")
    if idempotency_key is not None and (not isinstance(idempotency_key, str) or not idempotency_key.strip()):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "idempotency_key must be a non-empty string when provided")

    # defaults
    if same_host_only is None:
        same_host_only = True
    if fetch_content is None:
        fetch_content = True

    # ---- auth (ambient): pick any active key that can run this tool
    api_keys = _load("api_keys.json")
    requests_rows = _load("requests.json")

    active_keys = []
    for k in api_keys:
        if k.get("status") != "active":
            continue
        allowed = k.get("allowed_tools")
        if isinstance(allowed, list) and len(allowed) > 0 and tool not in allowed:
            continue
        # enforce schema constraint on rate_limit_rpm range if present
        rpm = k.get("rate_limit_rpm")
        if not isinstance(rpm, int) or rpm < 1 or rpm > 60000:
            continue
        active_keys.append(k)

    if not active_keys:
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "No active API key is available for this tool")

    # idempotency: requires knowing api_key_id; choose a key that already has that idempotency combo, else choose a usable key.
    selected_key = None
    if idempotency_key is not None:
        for k in active_keys:
            for r in requests_rows:
                if r.get("api_key_id") == k.get("id") and r.get("tool") == tool and r.get("idempotency_key") == idempotency_key:
                    # return existing response; do not create new requests row
                    resp = r.get("response")
                    return {
                        "request": r,
                        "job": resp.get("job") if isinstance(resp, dict) else None,
                        "response": resp,
                        "idempotent_replay": True,
                    }
        selected_key = active_keys[0]
    else:
        selected_key = active_keys[0]

    # usage month rollover
    cur_month = _month_key(now_dt)
    if selected_key.get("usage_month") != cur_month:
        selected_key["usage_month"] = cur_month
        selected_key["usage_requests"] = 0
        selected_key["usage_tokens"] = 0
        selected_key["updated_at"] = now_iso

    # rate limit + quotas: if exceeded -> create failed requests row with 429 and increment usage_requests (excluding auth failures)
    cutoff = now_dt - datetime.timedelta(seconds=60)
    recent = 0
    for r in requests_rows:
        if r.get("api_key_id") != selected_key.get("id"):
            continue
        created = _parse_iso(r.get("created_at"))
        if created and created >= cutoff:
            recent += 1
    if recent >= int(selected_key.get("rate_limit_rpm") or 0):
        # increment usage_requests
        selected_key["usage_requests"] = int(selected_key.get("usage_requests") or 0) + 1
        selected_key["updated_at"] = now_iso
        _save("api_keys.json", api_keys)

        req_row = _log_request(
            requests_rows,
            selected_key.get("id"),
            "failed",
            {
                "url": url,
                "max_depth": max_depth,
                "max_pages": max_pages,
                "allowed_path_prefixes": allowed_path_prefixes,
                "blocked_path_prefixes": blocked_path_prefixes,
                "same_host_only": same_host_only,
                "fetch_content": fetch_content,
                "idempotency_key": idempotency_key,
            },
            None,
            429,
            error_code="rate_limited",
            error_message="Rate limit exceeded for this API key (rpm). Try again later.",
            tokens_used=0,
            result_count=None,
            idem=idempotency_key,
            normalized_target=canonical_url,
            started_at=now_iso,
            finished_at=now_iso,
        )
        _save("requests.json", requests_rows)
        return _err("RATE_LIMIT", "Rate limit exceeded for this API key (rpm). Try again later.", request_id=req_row.get("id"))

    mrq = int(selected_key.get("monthly_request_quota") or 0)
    if mrq > 0 and int(selected_key.get("usage_requests") or 0) >= mrq:
        selected_key["usage_requests"] = int(selected_key.get("usage_requests") or 0) + 1
        selected_key["updated_at"] = now_iso
        _save("api_keys.json", api_keys)

        req_row = _log_request(
            requests_rows,
            selected_key.get("id"),
            "failed",
            {"url": url, "max_depth": max_depth, "max_pages": max_pages, "allowed_path_prefixes": allowed_path_prefixes, "blocked_path_prefixes": blocked_path_prefixes, "same_host_only": same_host_only, "fetch_content": fetch_content, "idempotency_key": idempotency_key},
            None,
            429,
            error_code="quota_exceeded",
            error_message="Monthly request quota exceeded for this API key.",
            tokens_used=0,
            idem=idempotency_key,
            normalized_target=canonical_url,
            started_at=now_iso,
            finished_at=now_iso,
        )
        _save("requests.json", requests_rows)
        return _err("QUOTA_EXCEEDED", "Monthly request quota exceeded for this API key.", request_id=req_row.get("id"))

    # create request row (queued)
    selected_key["usage_requests"] = int(selected_key.get("usage_requests") or 0) + 1
    selected_key["updated_at"] = now_iso
    _save("api_keys.json", api_keys)

    req_row = _log_request(
        requests_rows,
        selected_key.get("id"),
        "queued",
        {"url": url, "max_depth": max_depth, "max_pages": max_pages, "allowed_path_prefixes": allowed_path_prefixes, "blocked_path_prefixes": blocked_path_prefixes, "same_host_only": same_host_only, "fetch_content": fetch_content, "idempotency_key": idempotency_key},
        None,
        None,
        idem=idempotency_key,
        normalized_target=canonical_url,
        started_at=None,
        finished_at=None,
        tokens_used=0,
    )
    _save("requests.json", requests_rows)

    # upsert base web_resource
    web_resources = _load("web_resources.json")
    url_h = _url_hash(canonical_url)
    wr = None
    for r in web_resources:
        if r.get("url_hash") == url_h:
            wr = r
            break
    if wr is None:
        wr = {
            "id": _new_id("tav_url"),
            "canonical_url": canonical_url,
            "url_hash": url_h,
            "host": host,
            "title": None,
            "description": None,
            "content_text": None,
            "content_html": None,
            "content_storage_url": None,
            "content_mime_type": None,
            "http_status_last": None,
            "fetched_at": None,
            "first_seen_at": now_iso,
            "created_at": now_iso,
            "updated_at": now_iso,
            "status": "discovered",
        }
        web_resources.append(wr)
    else:
        wr["updated_at"] = now_iso
        if not wr.get("host"):
            wr["host"] = host
    _save("web_resources.json", web_resources)

    # create crawl job (unique request_id)
    crawl_jobs = _load("crawl_jobs.json")
    for j in crawl_jobs:
        if j.get("request_id") == req_row.get("id"):
            # should not happen; but keep idempotent-like behavior: return existing job
            resp = {"request": req_row, "job": j}
            req_row["response"] = resp
            req_row["updated_at"] = now_iso
            _save("requests.json", requests_rows)
            return resp

    job = {
        "id": _new_id("crawljob"),
        "request_id": req_row.get("id"),
        "mode": "crawl",
        "status": "queued",
        "base_web_resource_id": wr.get("id"),
        "max_depth": max_depth,
        "max_pages": max_pages,
        "allowed_path_prefixes": allowed_path_prefixes,
        "blocked_path_prefixes": blocked_path_prefixes,
        "same_host_only": bool(same_host_only),
        "fetch_content": True,  # crawl implies true
        "pages_discovered": 0,
        "pages_fetched": 0,
        "started_at": None,
        "finished_at": None,
        "created_at": now_iso,
        "updated_at": now_iso,
    }
    crawl_jobs.append(job)
    _save("crawl_jobs.json", crawl_jobs)

    # attach response envelope (no external work performed here)
    resp = {
        "request": req_row,
        "job": job,
    }
    # store response without marking terminal
    for i, r in enumerate(requests_rows):
        if r.get("id") == req_row.get("id"):
            requests_rows[i]["response"] = resp
            requests_rows[i]["updated_at"] = now_iso
            break
    _save("requests.json", requests_rows)

    # latency log is embedded in request row; return
    return resp

tool_schemas.name: tavily-map
tool_schemas.description: Creates a long-running site-mapping job that discovers and returns a structured set of URLs starting from the base url, exploring up to max_depth and stopping at max_pages while applying host/path constraints; returns the created job and its initial status (discovered URLs are produced asynchronously by the job). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when url is not a valid URI, max_depth < 0, max_pages < 1, or path prefix filters are invalid; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the API client is missing or not permitted to run mapping jobs; raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the client has no remaining map quota. Raises CONFLICT when the same idempotency_key is reused with different parameters, otherwise returns the existing map job for that key and does not create a duplicate job.

url.description: Base URL to start mapping from.

max_depth.description: Maximum link depth to explore when building the map.

max_pages.description: Maximum number of URLs to discover for the map.

allowed_path_prefixes.description: Only include/discover URLs whose path begins with one of these prefixes.

blocked_path_prefixes.description: Exclude URLs whose path begins with one of these prefixes.

same_host_only.description: If true, restrict mapping to the base URL host only.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key for safely retrying the same map without creating a duplicate job.

tool_schemas.name: tavily-whoami
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity and current entitlements for the presented API key, including allowed tools, key status, and rate-limit/quota usage counters; refuses with UNAUTHORIZED when the API key is missing/invalid and FORBIDDEN when the key is not active.

api_key.description: API key presented by the caller (sent as a parameter for server-to-server usage when an Authorization header is not available).

tool_schemas.implementation:
def tavily_whoami(api_key, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, hashlib, time
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0424000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0424000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    if not isinstance(api_key, str) or not api_key.strip():
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "api_key must be a non-empty string")

    api_keys = _load("api_keys.json")
    requests_log = _load("requests.json")

    # Authenticate by matching client-visible value (id or plaintext token), never by comparing against stored hash.
    # Since only a hash is stored, accept either:
    # - api_key matches api_keys.id, OR
    # - sha256(api_key) matches api_keys.key_hash (common vendor behavior)
    presented = api_key.strip()
    presented_sha = hashlib.sha256(presented.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

    key_row = None
    for r in api_keys:
        if r.get("id") == presented or r.get("key_hash") == presented_sha:
            key_row = r
            break

    if not key_row:
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Invalid API key")

    # Forbidden when not active (tool description)
    if key_row.get("status") != "active":
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "API key is not active", reason="FORBIDDEN")

    # whoami is not one of the metered tools in schema; but we still record request dynamics when a request log exists.
    # Use a synthetic tool name in the log but keep within enum by not writing if enum would be violated.
    # Since requests.tool enum doesn't include whoami, we cannot append without breaking schema; therefore only update last_used_at.
    # (Other tools will always be logged.)
    key_row["last_used_at"] = now
    key_row["updated_at"] = now
    _save("api_keys.json", api_keys)

    month = datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y-%m")
    usage_month = key_row.get("usage_month") or month
    # Do not mutate monthly windows here; just report.
    ent = {
        "api_key_id": key_row.get("id"),
        "key_prefix": key_row.get("key_prefix"),
        "label": key_row.get("label"),
        "owner_type": key_row.get("owner_type"),
        "owner_id": key_row.get("owner_id"),
        "status": key_row.get("status"),
        "allowed_tools": key_row.get("allowed_tools") or [],
        "rate_limit_rpm": key_row.get("rate_limit_rpm"),
        "monthly_request_quota": key_row.get("monthly_request_quota"),
        "monthly_token_quota": key_row.get("monthly_token_quota"),
        "usage_month": usage_month,
        "usage_requests": key_row.get("usage_requests", 0),
        "usage_tokens": key_row.get("usage_tokens", 0),
        "last_used_at": key_row.get("last_used_at"),
        "created_at": key_row.get("created_at"),
        "updated_at": key_row.get("updated_at"),
    }

    return {
        "ok": True,
        "identity": ent,
        "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
    }

tool_schemas.name: tavily-requests-list
tool_schemas.description: Lists request records created by the calling API key, optionally filtered by tool and status, returning a paginated result set sorted by created_at descending; refuses with FORBIDDEN when the API key is not active or does not have permission to access request history.

api_key.description: API key used to scope and authorize the request history query.

tool.description: Filter to only requests created for a specific tool.

status.description: Filter to only requests in the given lifecycle status.

idempotency_key.description: Filter to only requests with the given idempotency key.

created_after.description: Only include requests created at or after this timestamp (ISO 8601).

created_before.description: Only include requests created at or before this timestamp (ISO 8601).

limit.description: Maximum number of requests to return in this page.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous tavily-requests-list response.

tool_schemas.name: tavily-requests-get
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single request by id (including its stored input, response, error details, and final accounting fields) if it belongs to the calling API key; refuses with NOT_FOUND when the request does not exist or is not owned by the caller and FORBIDDEN when the API key is not active.

api_key.description: API key used to authorize access to the request.

tool_schemas.name: tavily-requests-cancel
tool_schemas.description: Cancels a queued or running long-running request (crawl/map) owned by the calling API key, transitioning both requests.status and the underlying crawl_job status to cancelled; refuses with CONFLICT if the request is already terminal (succeeded/failed/cancelled) or is not cancelable.

api_key.description: API key used to authorize the cancellation.

tool_schemas.name: tavily-crawl-jobs-get
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a crawl/map job by id (mode, limits, progress counters, and status) if it belongs to the calling API key via its parent request; refuses with NOT_FOUND when the job does not exist or is not owned by the caller and FORBIDDEN when the API key is not active.

api_key.description: API key used to authorize access to the crawl job.

tool_schemas.name: tavily-request-results-list
tool_schemas.description: Lists result items produced for a given request (search hits, extracted pages, crawled pages, or mapped URLs) with pagination and optional filtering by result_type; returns stable ordering by rank (when present) then created_at; refuses with NOT_FOUND when the request is not owned by the caller.

api_key.description: API key used to authorize access to request outputs.

request_id.description: Parent request id whose results should be listed.

result_type.description: Filter results to a specific type.

include_web_resource.description: If true, include selected web_resource fields (canonical_url, host, title, description, content_mime_type, http_status_last, fetched_at) inline with each result.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return in this page.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous tavily-request-results-list response.

metadata.name: Tavily Web Search and Extraction Server
metadata.description: This backend powers a web search, extraction, crawl, and site-mapping service similar to Tavily. It stores API clients, their requests (search/extract/crawl/map), and the resulting documents/URLs discovered, enforcing quotas, deduplication, and job lifecycles for long-running crawl/map operations.
